messages:
lucy_cs: Quick pulse  Mariner Analytics renewal is on the calendar but several asks from the customer: shorten to 7 months, seek a migration credit for moving from self-hosted to Redwood Dedicated, and request SOC2 evidence + activity log export for their auditors. They prefer CC but procurement may still need vendor docs. DocSend: https://docsend.com/view/mariner-renewal-2026

darren_se: FYI they also want BYOK flagged for later in the term. For Dedicated sizing we need projected token/month + concurrent requests if they migrate.

mira_ae: usage healthy but they run heavier nightly batch jobs. Migration could increase reserved concurrency. Recommend a migration plan and 2 training sessions.

anton_proc: CC route requires signed payment auth; fraud review applies for >$30k. PO route needs W9 (US) or VAT ID + remit address (EU). If they provide vendor docs we can create vendor code in ~48h. Which do they want?

paz_legal: For migration credit + audit export, propose clause: "Migration Credit: A one-time credit equal to 20% of the first three months' fees upon customer migration to Redwood Dedicated. Audit Logs: Redwood will provide activity logs per Appendix A; export will be delivered under an NDA and subject to data export policy." Any objections?

pricing-team: 7-month term -> apply 12% uplift to list. If we provide migration credit (20% x 3 months), we can soften uplift to 8%. If they prepay, reduce uplift by additional 3%. Need seat counts and token forecast to finalize numbers.

enablement: can offer two 2-hr migration workshops + runbook. Prefer scheduling after contract executes. Tentative windows wk of 5/10 or 5/17.

lucy_cs: i'll ask customer today: (1) PO vs CC, (2) who will sign and signer email, (3) seat count + token forecast, (4) whether SOC2 report copy acceptable or need additional attestations.

anton_proc: send vendor docs to procurement@redwood.com if PO. If CC, payment auth to payments@redwood.com. We'll advise on fraud timeline once we see amounts.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared: Mariner Analytics Renewal (SOW_v1 + Migration Amendment)  awaiting signer: sam@marineranalytics.com

lucy_cs: customer replied (via DM): prefer CC + payment auth, signer is sam@marineranalytics.com, SOC2 Type II PDF ok, will send token forecast next day. W9 to follow for backup.

paz_legal: legal ok with migration credit language, adding export NDA reference. Will attach sample NDA to DocSend.

pricing-team: once we get token forecast well issue final quote with uplift and migration credit line-item. Preliminary: 8% uplift with migration credit applied.

lucy_cs: TL;DR: Mariner prefers card + payment auth, DocuSign out, SOC2 accepted, W9 as backup, pricing pending token forecast. Target close in 72h if payment auth + signer return. :rocket:
